2610.13113.title: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation
2610.13113.paper_summary: Continual post-training faces a dual challenge of acquisition and retention: models must learn new capabilities while preserving prior knowledge. While Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) mitigates this using self-supervision with in-context demonstrations, it relies on strong in-context learning and instruction-following abilities. Consequently, SDFT fails on smaller models critical for low-latency, on-device use. To enable continual learning at smaller scales, we first identify the root cause of failure. We show that poor acquisition and forgetting correlate linearly with the post-trained model's distribution shift, revealing the necessity of in-distribution learning. We thus introduce Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf), imitating SDFT's in-distribution rewrite by outsourcing the task to a minimally larger, same-family aligner. Coupled with off-policy supervision and rejection sampling, this provides the high-quality supervision small models require without breaking their original distribution. Evaluations spanning 4 acquisition datasets (including a mixture) and 14 retention benchmarks show SynthSelf consistently outperforms 6 methods (including off- and on-policy distillation) across 3 small model scales. Extensive further analyses confirm SynthSelf paves the way toward effective small-model continual learning.
2610.13113.paper_summary_zh: 持續的後訓練面臨著獲取和保留的雙重挑戰：模型必須學習新能力，同時保留先前的知識。雖然自我蒸餾微調（SDFT）通過上下文示範的自我監督來減輕這一問題，但它依賴於強大的上下文學習和遵循指令的能力。因此，SDFT在對於低延遲、設備內使用至關重要的小型模型上失敗。為了在較小的規模上實現持續學習，我們首先確定失敗的根本原因。我們顯示出，獲取不良和遺忘與後訓練模型的分佈轉移線性相關，揭示了在分佈內學習的必要性。因此，我們引入了合成自我蒸餾（SynthSelf），通過將任務外包給一個最小增大的同一家族對齊器來模仿SDFT的分佈內重寫。結合離政策監督和拒絕抽樣，這為小型模型提供了所需的高質量監督，而不會破壞它們的原始分佈。跨越4個獲取數據集（包括混合）和14個保留基準的評估顯示，SynthSelf在3個小型模型規模上始終優於6種方法（包括離政策和在政策蒸餾）。廣泛的進一步分析確認SynthSelf為有效的小型模型持續學習鋪平了道路。
